configurationAndRuleFindings.finding: The named Azure Angel is a highly modified Delta-7 built by Anakin Skywalker, not a generic high-speed or high-maneuver configuration.
Printed laser +14 (+9 autofire), 7d10x2; proton torpedoes +14, 9d10x2. Sixteen torpedoes are payload, NOT launcher hardware count.
Availability none and cost Not available for sale; do not derive a credit price from the other Delta-7 variants.
Unlike variants requiring a booster ring, printed Azure Angel lines give 1 week supplies and x1 drive without a printed booster-ring condition.
Crew 1 plus astromech (ace); Mechanics and Use Computer use +13 astromech conditional modifiers.

Named Havoc variant operated by Nym substitutes astromech droids for gunner and navigator and has improved hyperdrive; not the printed standard prototype.
Asterisked -20 attack against targets smaller than Colossal results in +7 to -13 for bomblet generator.
